snippet.title: Hungry // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3381030/Hungry

Take control of a Boomble, a lively ball of energy with one mission: eat your way to victory. Gobble up orbs scattered across the map to grow in size and power. But be careful, if any of the other Boombles are bigger than you, they’ll swallow you whole!

Developed by
Quiphainyr Entertainment
